name: Pose Sketches - Hand drawn pose sketch of anything
description: You know what’s funny? Most people won’t hit the ' +add post ' button below — they’ll just scroll past, thinking their images aren’t worth the spotlight. But here’s the twist: that’s exactly why you should. Sharing’s not just about you; it quietly fuels the creators who keep this whole thing alive. I’m betting you’ve got something tucked away that’d surprise even yourself if you let it out. 💕 This LoRA ? It’s not like anyone’s obligated to care — but if it’s stirred something in you, maybe you’re the type who’d skip the Follow , like or comment just to prove a point. And Buzz ? Most wouldn’t bother. Yet, the few who do get it — they’re the ones who keep this rolling. I’m not asking you to join in; I’m just wondering if you’ll pass this up too. ❤️ Trigger word: Pose sketch Variation: Try add color lines for things that you want highlight, also, you can make it looks more human made adding orientations like reference lines, isometric or orthographic scenery sketch, etc Strength: between 0.5 to 0.75, experiment as you like✨
